label: Return request
prompt: I want to return a product.
text:
Returns are handled by our support team, not in-chat. I've opened a handoff — a specialist will follow up within 24 hours with the return instructions and the return form. You'll get a follow-up at the email on file.

If your vial arrived damaged, temperature-compromised, or wrong, mention that to the specialist so they can prioritise it.
